name: comp-53
title: Copy to Clipboard Input
description: A single-line read-only text field holding a value to reuse, with a copy button on the right. Hovering shows a small tooltip; clicking copies the text and briefly swaps the icon for a check.
use: A value people must reuse elsewhere, like an install command, invite link or ID, where copying is the main action.
avoid: The value is a hardcoded default and the button needs the Clipboard API, so it fails outside a secure context.
a11y: The button's aria-label changes to Copied and it disables itself; the scale transitions ignore reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded field with a subtle outline sits under a small label, the value left-aligned in grey-white and a faint copy glyph at the right end. A grey rounded speech bubble floats just above the field while it is hovered.
behaves: Hovering the icon pops a small tooltip above the field. A click writes the field's value to the clipboard, the copy glyph shrinks away as a green check fades in, the button goes dead to further clicks, and after about a second and a half the icon returns.
customise: Nothing is exposed as a prop: the label, the command string and the tooltip copy are literals, so putting in your own value means editing the file.
weight: light: A field, one button and an occasional tooltip; one short scale transition.
